name: AI-Skill-Library
purpose: Current installed skill inventory plus independently authored, provenance-aware portable skill alternatives.
not_done: The original host-managed bodies for the 148 catalog entries have not been exported. The 154 portable guides are independent equivalents, not exact recovery of proprietary/plugin-managed text.
146 portable guides are UNLICENSED. No redistribution, bundling, hosting, or commercial-use permission is granted for those files until a compatible license is selected.
Host-specific CLI discovery, activation, invocation, and evaluation tests have not been run for Codex, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, and Grok.
No comprehensive skill-level static/dynamic security assessment has been completed.
No matched baseline-versus-skill evaluation report exists across the 154 guides and five hosts; 1,540 routing prompts are seed data only.
No versioned release package, SBOM, build provenance attestation, or signature-verification process has been published.
principles: Do not redistribute proprietary/plugin-hosted skill bodies without rights.
Pin source commits and record Git object identifiers for published files.
Review each license at file/subtree level.
Scan and manually inspect before execution.
Measure skill lift against a matched baseline.
Use host adapters rather than forking canonical content.
Distinguish format validation from host runtime compatibility and task evaluation.
Do not declare commercial readiness while a release gate remains blocked.
upstream_policy: read_only_drift_scan_issue_notification_only; no automatic source pin or skill content updates
